set.body: Bug found during the visual gallery gate: default point glyphs centered at trained x/y extrema are clipped by the panel boundary. Add a typed, explicit range-expansion policy with a default roughly matching continuous-scale 5% framing and a none opt-out. Apply it only to compiler-derived panel ranges, never explicit PanelLayout ranges or trained scale domains. Acceptance: minimal device-space regression proves all corner-disc bounds lie inside the panel clip at 640x480; scaled, unscaled, degenerate, and opt-out behavior are covered; graphics and graphics-svg pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Graphics: prevent default point clipping at trained range corners
